llm.summary: This is a straightforward markdown-based todo helper whose file operations are disclosed and limited to the declared project todo workflow.

dimensions.detail: The skill’s stated purpose is managing markdown todo files in a todos/ directory, and the artifacts consistently describe naming, frontmatter, templates, triage, dependencies, and completion workflows for that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime guidance includes normal local file operations such as creating, renaming, searching, and editing todo markdown files, with examples using ls, grep, cp, and mv; these are scoped to todos/ and are coherent with the skill’s purpose.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains markdown documentation and templates only, with no executable scripts, install hooks, or hidden runtime components identified in the artifact list.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Project filesystem access is needed to manage todo files, and the references do not request network access, credentials, broad local indexing, destructive cleanup, or unrelated data access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill intentionally creates persistent markdown task records in the repository, but shows no background workers, privilege escalation, credential/session handling, or automatic execution beyond user-directed todo management.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install this if you want agents to create and maintain markdown todo files in your project. Expect it to add, rename, and update files under todos/; review those changes before committing if your todo files may include sensitive project details.
llm.findings:
[EA1] expected: The cited artifact text does not show a blanket tool grant; it distinguishes this file-based todo system from an in-memory TodoWrite tool. Shell/file operations are expected for managing todos/ and are not evidence of unrestricted agency by themselves.
[P2] expected: The cited hidden-instruction concern is based on visible HTML comments in SPEC.md that are maintenance placeholders, not runtime instructions or unauthorized directives.
